sloka: शक्तिभिः परिघैः घोरैः अतिमात्रैः च कार्मुकैः ।गदा असि मुसलैः वज्रैः गृहीतैः भीम दर्शनैः ॥३-२२-१९॥
transliteration: śaktibhiḥ parighaiḥ ghoraiḥ atimātraiḥ ca kārmukaiḥ ।gadā asi musalaiḥ vajraiḥ gṛhītaiḥ bhīma darśanaiḥ ॥3-22-19॥

translations.english: Then the army of the demons wearing dreadful shields, holding weapons and flags, and making a loud noise started in great speed from Janasthanam.
